trailhead.label: The Kaiserstein car park on the Costalunga road, the board’s start

cautions: The start is beside the busy Costalunga road: keep your dog on a short lead in the car park.
A steady climb of nearly 190 m in 1.5 km: let your dog set the pace.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
